reviews.title: A Must Have GLP-1 Tracking Tool
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about this amazing tracker. I found it last year when I began my GLP-1 journey and I can’t imagine not using it. This is app not only reminds you to take your weekly injection, it is also filled with useful data. It tracks your injection locations and shows you the correlative weight loss at different sites. This is a game changer and it’s not predictive - it based on the data … YOUR data. One of my favorite features is the estimated levels of medication in your body throughout the week. Why? It helps me plan where I want to be when it is at peak level and I might start to feel queasy. It’s the 24-hour mark for me and this helped me choose 10 pm on Saturday for my injections. This app provides everything you need to understand how your body is reacting to your GLP-1. Just get it. You will be glad you did.

reviews.title: A Must Have for My Zepbound Journey
reviews.text:
Shotsy has honestly been such a helpful app throughout my Zepbound journey. I just used notes before LOL. It makes it so much easier to keep track of my injections, weight, progress, and how I’m feeling along the way.

What I really appreciate is that it helps me see the bigger picture instead of getting caught up in one random weigh-in or one difficult week. When you’re on a GLP-1, progress isn’t always perfectly linear, so having everything tracked in one place has been really motivating. I’ve been using Zepbound as part of a long-term weight-loss journey, and having an app like Shotsy makes me feel more organized and accountable without making the process feel overwhelming.

I love this app! I thought I didn’t need it but after the trial, I knew it was a great tool for my Zepbound journey.  

I love tracking my progress on the app. Also calculating the average of my calories and protein is very helpful. It’s fun to see my weight loss in a chart and showing my total loss. 

Seeing the estimated amount of Zepbound in my body on a daily basis helps me understand what’s going on in my body. 

The one thing I thought I wouldn’t use is the tracking of where I gave my last shot.  I thought I’d remember it. I was wrong. After five weeks I had to check the app to see where my last shot was. I did not remember. 

Overall, this app is a wonderful tool if you’re on a GLP-1. I’m so happy I found it, and it’s worth the modest amount it costs for all cool features you get. Many thanks to the developers that made it. 😊❤️

reviews.title: Could be great?
reviews.text:
Honestly, I’m writing this at the end of a week free trial and I’m underwhelmed. Firstly, because for a weekly-dosed drug like Zepbound, a week is hardly time enough to see what the potential really is. 

I may be an edge case since at least as I get started I’ve not yet encountered much in the way of side effects worth tracking, but it just doesn’t seem to provide much that a spreadsheet wouldn’t. 

Visualizations are…decent? But aside from the med level graphic they all seem to depend on external data so you still have to choose a calorie/protein tracker, too. 

If there was a month-long trial, I’d certainly take another look and see if there is inherent value on a longer-term basis, but I just didn’t see $60/yr worth there right now.

I’m using this along with the GLP-1 program on Noom, so data is shared easily between the apps and Apple Health.  This app keeps track of the medical side of things while Noom keeps track of the dietary, and Apple Health facilitates data sharing for a complete picture.  I really appreciate the level of detail on dosages, the side effect tracking, and keeping track of the last shot location because I forget those small details.

reviews.title: Great way to track shots
reviews.text: Weight loss from shot to shot can be deceiving because weight varies from day to day. I think a lot of users would appreciate an option to see a 7-day average that shows the weight trend. They may see that even though technically the weight is up on shot day, their overall weight average is trending down each week.
This has been a literal blessing for my weighloss journey.
